source: Enchanting, second mode — Pathfinder 1st Edition magic item creation (Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Wondrous Item, Forge Ring). Open Game Content, Open Game License v1.0a — see OGL.txt.
note: This file is the book-faithful mode's catalogue, and it is deliberately NOT the essence shelf: rules/magicitem.py reads only this file (plus homebrew/magic-items), while rules/enchanter.py reads the whole content/materials folder as the shared shelf. Kinds: weapon_property and armour_property (priced as BONUS EQUIVALENTS — `plus` is added to the enhancement bonus for pricing and counts against the +10 cap), wondrous (slot items priced in gp outright, `slot` from rules/tables.py SLOTS). `spell` is the prerequisite spell as a real id in content/spells; the creator satisfies it either by knowing it (rules/casting.knows) or by consuming a potion whose stock entry carries "holds_spell": that id. Permanency prerequisites from the book are dropped — see docs/enchanting.md. `caster_level` is the book's minimum; the working's DC is 5 + caster level. Effects are rules/effectspec.py specs where the vocabulary reaches and narrative where it does not; a guessed spec would be a fact nobody wrote. Wondrous rows are also the enchanter's recipes (docs/enchanting-contracts.md §5, read through rules/materials.recipes()): `book` (what the item does, by hand from the AoN page in `source`), `spells` (groups, any one of each), `caster_level` and `creator_level` (the book's two numbers, kept apart), `creator` (the book's other creator clauses), `essences` (the grants or families a binding needs), `not_yet` (every clause nothing runs yet). `tier` is the price band (under 1,000 gp common, 5,000 uncommon, 20,000 rare, 50,000 exotic, then legendary), checked on load. `retired` rows could not be found in the book and are never offered.

creator: 5 ranks in Swim

materials.name: Elixir of Truth
materials.text: Book: the drinker must answer questions truthfully for 10 minutes. One use.

effects.target: The drinker answers questions truthfully for 10 minutes (Will DC 13 negates)

book.tell: The drinker can say nothing but the truth

not_yet: Ten minutes, Will DC 13 negates, and a further save against each question: no save is rolled yet.

materials.name: Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone)
materials.text: Book: a +1 luck bonus on saving throws, ability checks and skill checks. Slotless, and one of the most-carried items in the game.
not_yet: The book's +1 luck bonus is on ability checks and skill checks as well; here only the saves.

materials.name: Pearl of Power (1st level)
materials.text: Book: once per day, recalls one 1st-level spell already cast. Slotless.

effects.target: Once per day, recall one 1st-level spell already cast

book.tell: The pearl returns a spell already cast that day

not_yet: Recalls one 1st-level spell a prepared caster cast that day; the slot is not yet restored by it.
creator: able to cast 1st-level spells

materials.name: Necklace of Fireballs (type I)
materials.text: Book: beads that detach and explode as fireballs.
not_yet: Type I: one 6d6 sphere and two 4d6, thrown up to 70 feet, Reflex DC 14 half; read as fireballs at caster level 6 and 4.
A failed save against magical fire can set off every sphere left.

materials.name: Horn of Fog
materials.text: Book: blows a thick fog, as obscuring mist. Slotless.

materials.name: Rope of Climbing
materials.text: Book: a 60-foot rope that knots, fastens and unfastens on command. Slotless.

effects.target: Moves, knots and fastens itself on command

book.tell: The rope climbs, knots and fastens itself where it is told

not_yet: 60 feet, holds 3,000 lb.; knotted, it lowers Climb DCs by 10.

materials.name: Goggles of Minute Seeing
materials.text: Book: +5 competence on Disable Device checks. The old row gave Perception; the book's lenses see fine work within a foot.

materials.name: Medallion of Thoughts
materials.text: Book: detect thoughts, three times per day.

materials.name: Boots of the Winterlands
materials.text: Book: warms the wearer as endure elements, and carries her over snow and ice. The old row's cold resistance 5 is not in the book and is gone.

effects.target: Leaves no tracks in snow; moves normally over ice and deep snow

not_yet: Travel over snow at full speed leaving no tracks, and over ice without slipping.

materials.name: Glove of Storing
materials.text: Book: one held item is shrunk to nothing on command and returned as a free action.

effects.target: Stores one held item, retrieved as a free action

book.tell: The glove takes the held thing into its palm, and gives it back at a snap

not_yet: One item of up to 20 lb., stored or drawn as a free action.

materials.name: Efficient Quiver
materials.text: Book: holds far more than it should — arrows, bows and spears. Slotless.

effects.target: Holds 60 arrows, 18 javelins and 6 bows or staves at no weight

book.tell: The quiver holds far more than it should and gives up what is asked

not_yet: 60 arrows, 18 javelins and 6 bows or staves, at 2 lb.; not yet read.

materials.name: Scarab of Protection
materials.text: Book: spell resistance 20 against harmful spells and absorbs 12 negative-energy or death effects.

effects.target: SR 20 against harmful spells; absorbs 12 death or negative-energy effects, then crumbles

not_yet: Absorbs twelve energy drains, death effects or negative energy effects, then turns to powder.
Spell resistance is recorded; the cast path rolls no check against it until lane C's reader lands.

materials.name: Mantle of Spell Resistance
materials.text: Book: spell resistance 21.
not_yet: Spell resistance is recorded; the cast path rolls no check against it until lane C's reader lands.

materials.name: Ring of Counterspells
materials.text: Book: holds one stored spell, which is counterspelled automatically if cast at the wearer.

effects.target: Automatically counters the one spell stored in it

book.tell: The spell held in the ring breaks the same spell cast at its wearer

not_yet: Holds one spell of 1st to 6th level, cast into it; nothing stores it yet.

materials.name: Bracers of Archery, Lesser
materials.text: Book: +1 competence on attack rolls with bows. The old row also gave +1 damage, which is the greater bracers'.
not_yet: The +1 is with bows only, and the bracers grant bow proficiency; here it is on every attack.
creator: Craft Magic Arms and Armor
proficient with a longbow or shortbow

materials.name: Belt of Mighty Hurling, Lesser
materials.text: Ultimate Equipment: +2 enhancement to Strength; thrown weapons use Strength to hit and fly 10 feet further. The old row's +2 to attack was not the book's.
not_yet: The book's bonus is a temporary one for the first 24 hours worn, then counts for hit points and skill ranks; here it is a standing bonus while worn.
Thrown weapons may use Strength for the attack instead of Dexterity, and their range increment gains 10 feet.

materials.name: Headband of Mental Prowess +2/+2
materials.text: Book: +2 enhancement to two mental ability scores at once. The two-stat headbands are why the slot is so contested.
not_yet: The book's bonus is a temporary one for the first 24 hours worn, then counts for hit points and skill ranks; here it is a standing bonus while worn.
The book's two scores are chosen at making; this recipe is the Intelligence and Wisdom one.

materials.name: Belt of Physical Perfection +2
materials.text: Book: +2 enhancement to all three physical ability scores.
not_yet: The book's bonus is a temporary one for the first 24 hours worn, then counts for hit points and skill ranks; here it is a standing bonus while worn.

materials.name: Vest of Resistance +1
materials.text: Book: a +1 resistance bonus on saves, in the chest slot — for a character whose shoulders are already spoken for.
materials.why_retired: Not in the book: Found only on a fan site, not on AoN.

materials.name: Shirt of Gliding
materials.text: Book: glide safely from a height, twice per day.
materials.why_retired: Not in the book: Not found.

materials.name: Robe of Eyes
materials.text: Book: all-round vision, darkvision 120 feet, see invisible, and blindness if struck by light.

drawbacks.target: A light or daylight spell blinds the wearer for 1d3 minutes

not_yet: Sees in all directions: keeps its Dexterity bonus when flat-footed and cannot be flanked; sees the ethereal too.
Cannot avert its eyes from a gaze; light blinds it for 1d3 minutes and daylight for 2d4.

materials.name: Gauntlet of Rust-Free Blades
materials.text: Book-style minor item: weapons held in this gauntlet never rust, corrode or dull. A cheap first commission, and a good excuse to learn the ritual.

effects.target: Weapons held never rust, corrode or dull

materials.why_retired: Not in the book: Not found (the id and the name disagree, too).

materials.text: Book-style minor item: the wearer breathes water for 10 minutes per day.
materials.why_retired: Not in the book: Not found; Ultimate Equipment has a cap of the free thinker, a different item.

materials.name: Sandals of Quiet Tread

book.tell: Thoughts, lies and leanings cannot be read from the wearer

effects.target: Cannot be located or detected by divination or scrying

book.tell: Scrying and locating magic slide off the wearer

not_yet: As nondetection: a divination against the wearer needs a caster level check against DC 19.

materials.name: Minor Crown of Blasting
materials.text: Book: a searing light ray, twice per day.

materials.name: Goggles of the Charmed Gaze
materials.text: Book-style minor item: a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks, and the wearer's eyes catch the light oddly.
materials.why_retired: Not in the book: Not found; the Core Rulebook's eyes of charming are a different item at 56,000 gp.

materials.name: Ring of Arrow Deflection
materials.text: Book: once per round, deflects one ranged attack that would have hit.

effects.target: Once per round, deflect one ranged attack that would have hit

materials.why_retired: Not in the book: Not found; arrow deflection is a shield property (lane A's table).

materials.name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
materials.text: Book: +2 enhancement to Constitution, +4 on Diplomacy with dwarves, and darkvision 60 feet.

The Constitution, darkvision, stonecunning and +2 resistance on saves against poison, spells and spell-like effects are for a wearer who is not a dwarf; here they apply to anyone.
